hook.text: These rings look solid. But fly closer, and Saturn’s perfect circles become something stranger.
hook.promise: Reveal individual particles behind Saturn’s ring silhouette

design.visualThesis: Distance turns a swarm of separate ice fragments into apparently solid rings.
design.motionGrammar: Motivated push-in, match cut to particle scale, size reveal, pullback
design.assetLanguage: Original procedural geometry; physically illustrative scale

scenes.narration: These rings look solid. But fly closer, and Saturn’s perfect circles become something stranger.
Billions of separate pieces. Mostly ice, mixed with rock and dust. Each one follows its own path around Saturn.
scenes.visual: Track moving faceted ice in a flat field

motion.action: Track moving faceted ice in a flat field

scenes.narration: Some are tiny grains. Others are as big as a house. From far away, all those pieces blend into bands.
scenes.visual: Reveal small and large fragments then compress the field in perspective

motion.action: Reveal small and large fragments then compress the field in perspective
motion.settle: Different sizes share a ring plane

scenes.narration: The rings even orbit at different speeds. So the next time you see Saturn, imagine countless icy worlds in motion.
scenes.visual: Show two highlighted orbital lanes and pull back to full Saturn

motion.action: Show two highlighted orbital lanes and pull back to full Saturn
motion.settle: Recognizable planet with distinct ring bands

outro.takeaway: Saturn’s rings are separate orbiting particles.
outro.cta: Next time you see Saturn, imagine the individual pieces.
